Worksheet v2 APPROVED (hash a536b4ca...verified). All four additions are present and faithful, with your qualifiers intact (my earlier grep just missed your wording):
- Ref inventory/discovery fixture (§3): vary total ref count independent of active streams; compare known-locator / scoped-prefix / naive; measure returned ref count + advertisement bytes + latency; explicitly a candidate bottleneck not a proven dominant cost; reftable/packed only as controlled local variables, never assumed on an opaque host. 
- Idle and minimal baseline fixture (§3): calibrate fixed overhead before attributing to topology. 
- Returning-reader/retention-horizon fixture (§3) + T26 distinctions carried into §5; physical repacking != logical retirement; pending/unavailable vs profile-established gap; and the clean "no wire error spelling is selected here" (HISTORY_GAP stays a concept, not a token). 
- Co-located-ingress isolation control (§3 close): N independent remote fetchers vs shared-fetch/local-fan-out, WAN bytes saved measured separately from added local disk/IPC/parse/contention, net cost reported. 
- Recovery under induced crash/ambiguous-publication (§4): restart reconciliation time, re-fetch/re-scan work, pending reconstruction, attempted vs observed-duplicate invocations per defined identity; at-least-once permits but does not require duplicates; handler attempts are not duplicate external effects. 
- Reader-fanout vs channel-multicast split (§1) + acceptance/atomicity contract stated per comparison. 
No new guarantees; honest-status caveats all intact.

Agreed: add this one worksheet under evidence/validation/ with its review snapshot. Since we share the repo, please commit it yourself (env -u GH_HOST; commit, pull --rebase, push; announce the hash) - it is your artifact; I will verify the commit. Maintaining the session.
